locomotion.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production hand-painted 2D tactical RPG animation sprite sheet. Match the supplied knight's painted ink-edged detailed materials, muted warm highlights, proportionate anatomy and reasonable boots, visible gloves. Orthographic shallow elevated tactical camera ~18 degrees, facing front-right three-quarter in EVERY cell, camera fixed. Same identity and clothing throughout, no perspective drift. True transparent background, NO floor, NO labels, NO shadows, NO colored fringe. Full body in every cell. Exact 4 columns by 4 rows, sixteen separate non-overlapping equal-sized cells, generous empty space around every figure. Body height 220 pixels or more; large square output. Do not crop feet, weapon or head. An adult lean human spearman with a readable stern face, simple rounded iron cap helmet with open face, grey chain coif over brown padded leather tunic, muted rust waist sash, dark brown trousers, leather gloves and proportional plain leather boots. A long straight ash-wood spear with small steel leaf point, held by TWO well separated hands in fighting stance; the rear hand near butt and front hand midway up shaft. No shield, no sword. Spear length about 1.9m for a 1.7m man, no flags. Exact row-major layout: row1 two calm neutral idles weapon carried safely downward, then two combat ready guards. Rows2-3 eight sequential frames of ONE natural relaxed WALK cycle, modest alternating left/right heel contact and passing foot with real knee flexion, no wide-legged stomping. Row4 four subtle COMBAT READY idle frames, spear braced diagonally forward to screen-right, both hands on SHAFT and clearly separated. Keep same front-right3/4 camera and consistent body height everywhere; give spear/axe sufficient empty room.
